wildways.guide.title: WildWays Guide
Enter the Quarantine Grounds. Explore the ruins in the taiga to discover what became of a forgotten civilization overrun by an ancient parasite.
wildways.guide.quest.kill_endermite.desc: Kill an Endermite. Look for them in the Quarantine Grounds or try throwing Ender Pearls.
wildways.guide.quest.shell.description: Collect an Endermite Shell dropped by an Endermite.
wildways.guide.quest.nest.description: Craft an Endermite Nest by surrounding a chest with eight Endermite Shells.
wildways.guide.quest.packed_nest.descrip: Put items inside a placed Endermite Nest, then break it and pick it up with its contents still inside.
wildways.guide.quest.endermite_eye.descr: Leave an Eye of Ender in an Endermite Nest until it turns into an Eye of the Endermite, then collect it.
wildways.guide.quest.bricks.description: Craft Endermite Bricks with an Endermite Shell in the middle and four Stone Bricks around it.
wildways.guide.quest.brew_unease.descrip: Brew an Awkward Potion with an Endermite Shell, then take the Potion of Unease from the brewing stand.
wildways.guide.quest.plant_seed.descript: Plant any crop to start a garden. Wheat seeds will do.
Till soil with a diamond or Volcanite hoe. Crops grow faster on the tilled soil.
wildways.guide.quest.till_netherite_farm: Till soil with a netherite hoe for the fastest crop growth.
wildways.guide.quest.find_cycad.descript: Pick up a cycad that a Sniffer dug up.
wildways.guide.quest.compost_cycad.descr: Put a cycad in an empty composter. Fill it with cycads, torchflowers or pitcher plants, then collect the compost.
wildways.guide.quest.till_compost.descri: Place a block of compost and till it with a hoe. Some crops give a bigger harvest on this soil.
wildways.guide.quest.find_sniffer_flower: Pick up a pitcher pod or torchflower seeds that a Sniffer dug up.
Plant a pitcher pod on farmland. It keeps the soil moist up to three blocks away.
wildways.guide.quest.torchflower_light.d: Place a mature torchflower to light up your garden.
wildways.guide.quest.gold_ripen.descript: Let crops finish growing next to a mature torchflower or pitcher plant. You might find Gold-Ripened seeds in the harvest.
Try the same thing on compost farmland. Crops grown there are more likely to yield Gold-Ripened seeds.
wildways.guide.quest.eat_gold_ripened_st: Cook a Gold-Ripened potato, then use it with a Gold-Ripened carrot to make rabbit stew. Eat a bowl.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_fishing_rod.d: Craft a fishing rod from sticks and string.
wildways.guide.quest.hunt_livestock.desc: Slaughter a farm animal for meat.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_magnifying_gl: Craft a magnifying glass from a spyglass and paper. Use it on an animal to check its weight and living conditions.
wildways.guide.quest.perfect_habitat.des: Give a farm animal grass, light, water and room to move. Check the pasture with your magnifying glass.
wildways.guide.quest.hunt_heavy_livestoc: Raise a farm animal until the magnifying glass shows a weight of 8, then slaughter it.
wildways.guide.quest.bait.description: Obtain Beetroot Dough. Craft it with wheat and beetroot, then combine it with a fishing rod to load 16 bait charges.
wildways.guide.quest.rich_fish.descripti: Obtain a rich fish. Fish with Beetroot Dough and follow the target when the bobber dips. Rich fish sparkle and give more saturation.
wildways.guide.quest.compass.description: Hold a compass to see your coordinates and the direction you are facing.
wildways.guide.quest.biome_compass.descr: Get a Biome Compass from a Wandering Trader.
wildways.guide.quest.locate_biome.descri: Use a Biome Compass and select a biome it can find. Follow the needle to your destination.
wildways.guide.quest.structure_map.descr: Find a map that points to a structure. Vanilla explorer maps count too.
wildways.guide.quest.trade_structure_map: Buy a structure map from a Wandering Trader.
wildways.guide.quest.igloo_map.descripti: Look for an Igloo Map in a snowy village.
wildways.guide.quest.dungeon_map.descrip: Look for a Monster Room Map in an abandoned camp or a mineshaft.
wildways.guide.quest.mineshaft_map.descr: Look for a Mineshaft Map in a monster room or an abandoned camp.
wildways.guide.quest.trail_ruins_map.des: Look for a Trail Ruins Map in the Quarantine Grounds.
wildways.guide.quest.pillager_outpost_ma: Get a Pillager Outpost Map from a Pillager Patrol Captain.
wildways.guide.quest.jungle_temple_map.d: Fish in a jungle for a chance to find a Jungle Temple Map.
wildways.guide.quest.desert_temple_map.d: Brush suspicious sand in a desert well to look for a Desert Temple Map.
wildways.guide.quest.swamp_hut_map.descr: Fish in a swamp for a chance to find a Swamp Hut Map.
wildways.guide.quest.ancient_city_map: A Map to the Deep Dark
wildways.guide.quest.ancient_city_map.de: Look for an Ancient City Map in the supply chests of a Trial Chamber.
wildways.guide.quest.land_with_worn_elyt: Keep gliding when your Elytra reaches its last point of durability, then land safely.
wildways.guide.quest.read_light_sensor.d: Hold a Light Sensor to display the local light level above your hotbar.
wildways.guide.quest.read_clock.descript: Hold a clock to read the time on its dial and the current day above your hotbar.
wildways.guide.quest.mine_with_copper.de: Break a block with a copper tool. Try a copper pickaxe on stone to see how quickly it mines.
wildways.guide.quest.refine_iron.descrip: Use a Gold, Amethyst or Quartz Refinement to upgrade an iron tool, weapon or armor piece at a Smithing Table.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_gold_refineme: Craft a Gold Refinement with four gold ingots around an iron ingot.
wildways.guide.quest.refine_gold.descrip: Use a Gold Refinement at a Smithing Table to upgrade a piece of iron equipment to gold.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_amethyst_refi: Craft an Amethyst Refinement with four amethyst shards around an iron ingot.
wildways.guide.quest.amethyst_combat.des: Land a hit that deals damage with an amethyst tool or weapon. Amethyst lets you attack faster.
wildways.guide.quest.wear_amethyst_armor: Equip all four pieces of amethyst armor to increase your agility.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_quartz_refine: Craft a Quartz Refinement with four quartz around an iron ingot.
wildways.guide.quest.quartz_tool.descrip: Obtain any quartz tool or weapon. Refine its iron equivalent at a Smithing Table to improve its durability.
wildways.guide.quest.wear_quartz_armor.d: Equip all four pieces of quartz armor to try the more durable set.
Find and collect Raw Volcanite. Look for its ore among the basalt in a Basalt Delta.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_volcanite_ref: Smelt Raw Volcanite, then craft a Volcanite Refinement with four Volcanite Ingots around an emerald.
wildways.guide.quest.volcanite_tool.desc: Obtain any Volcanite tool or weapon. Refine quartz, amethyst or gold equipment at a Smithing Table. Volcanite extends your reach.
wildways.guide.quest.wear_volcanite_armo: Equip all four pieces of Volcanite armor to place blocks from farther away.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_diamond_refin: Craft a Diamond Refinement with four diamonds around an emerald.
wildways.guide.quest.refine_diamond.desc: Upgrade a quartz, amethyst or gold tool, weapon or armor piece with a Diamond Refinement at a Smithing Table.
wildways.guide.quest.fletch_arrows.descr: Make any arrow at a Fletching Table. For ordinary arrows, put a feather on the left, a stick in the middle and flint on the right.
wildways.guide.quest.fletch_turtle_arrow: Combine ordinary arrows with a turtle scute at a Fletching Table to make Turtle Arrows.
Combine ordinary arrows with a phantom membrane at a Fletching Table to make Range Arrows.
wildways.guide.quest.fletch_explosive_ar: Combine ordinary arrows with TNT at a Fletching Table to make Explosive Arrows.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_rune.descript: Craft a rune of any tier. Runes determine the enchantment level you can apply. Start with a Copper Rune or check the recipe book for higher tiers.
wildways.guide.quest.rune_enchanting.des: Enchant a piece of equipment at an enchanting table using lapis, a rune and an enchanted book. The book stays in the table for reuse.
Apply a level V enchantment. Try Efficiency on a pickaxe with a Volcanite Rune. Surround the table with twenty bookshelves.
wildways.guide.quest.craft_enchanting_ca: Craft an Enchanting Catalyst. Put a Sculk Catalyst in the center, chiseled stone bricks in the corners, lapis blocks above and below, and blaze powder to either side.
wildways.guide.quest.use_enchanting_cata: Use an Enchanting Catalyst at the enchanting table to save levels. Choose an enchantment that would normally cost at least two levels.
wildways.guide.quest.mending.description: Obtain a piece of equipment enchanted with Mending. At the enchanting table, Mending requires at least a Golden Rune.
wildways.guide.quest.repair_mending_item: Put a damaged item enchanted with Mending into an anvil with one matching repair material. Take the repaired item from the output slot.
wildways.guide.quest.stack_potions.descr: Stack eight identical potions in a single inventory slot. Splash and lingering potions also stack to eight.
wildways.guide.quest.brew_level_two.desc: Brew a stronger potion with glowstone dust. Try a Potion of Strength or a Potion of Swiftness, then take the upgraded potion from the brewing stand.
wildways.guide.quest.brew_supreme.descri: Add popped chorus fruit to a strong Potion of Swiftness, Leaping, Strength, Healing or Regeneration. Take the Supreme potion from the brewing stand.
wildways.guide.quest.drink_supreme.descr: Drink any Supreme potion. Try its effect and see what side effect comes with it.
wildways.guide.quest.brew_fatal.descript: Add popped chorus fruit to a strong Potion of Slowness, Harming or Poison. Take the Fatal potion from the brewing stand.
wildways.guide.quest.use_fatal.descripti: Use a Fatal splash or lingering potion on a mob. Turn a drinkable potion into a splash potion with gunpowder.
wildways.guide.quest.tip_eight_arrows.de: Take a batch of eight tipped arrows from a Fletching Table. Put eight ordinary arrows in the middle slot and a potion on the right.
wildways.guide.quest.tip_stack_arrows.de: Use a lingering potion and a stack of 64 arrows at a Fletching Table. Take the whole batch of tipped arrows from the result slot.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_ice.descript: Look for an Eye of Ice in the chests of snowy villages or igloos.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_water.descri: Drop an Eye of Ender in water or rain within range of an active conduit. Collect it after it transforms.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_sulfur.descr: Drop an Eye of Ender into the water directly above Potent Sulfur and collect the Eye of Sulfur.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_the_tiger.de: Search the treasure chests in a jungle temple for the Eye of the Tiger.
wildways.guide.quest.lost_eye.descriptio: Brush suspicious gravel in Trail Ruins or search the hidden Endermite Bunker in the Quarantine Grounds for a Lost Eye.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_storm.descri: Place an Eye of Ender in the center of a crafting table, Breeze Rods in the corners, and Wind Charges on the four sides.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_the_brute.de: Defeat Piglin Brutes in a bastion and collect an Eye of the Brute from their drops.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_the_creaking: Strike a Creaking in a Pale Garden and look for the eye it can drop.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_brewing.desc: Brew an Eye of Ender with nether wart, then add a phantom membrane and finally a ghast tear.
wildways.guide.quest.enchanted_eye.descr: Craft the eye with an Eye of Ender in the center, amethyst shards in the corners and lapis on the sides. At an enchanting table, use an Attunement book, a rune and lapis to enchant it.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_volcanite.de: Craft an Eye of Volcanite with an Eye of Ender and four Volcanite Ingots in a cross. Drop the eye in fire to prepare it for the End portal.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_illagers.des: Drop an Eye of Ender near an Evoker and wait for it to cast its spell. Collect the result.
wildways.guide.quest.eye_of_darkness.des: Craft an Eye of Darkness with an Eye of Ender and four Echo Shards.
wildways.guide.quest.collect_portal_eyes: Discover the keys to the End. Carry twelve different WildWays eyes at the same time. Eyes in Shulker Boxes or Endermite Nests you carry count too.
wildways.guide.quest.activate_end_portal: Open an End portal by placing twelve different portal-ready eyes into its frames.
wildways.guide.quest.find_wither_skull.d: Hunt wither skeletons in a Nether fortress for a skull.
wildways.guide.quest.find_sculk_wither_s: Look for a Sculk-Covered Wither Skull in an Ancient City.
wildways.guide.quest.find_gold_wither_sk: Search a Bastion Remnant for a Gold-Adorned Wither Skull. Start in the treasure room if it has one.
wildways.guide.quest.summon_wither.descr: Collect all three skulls first. Build a T from soul sand or soul soil. Put the regular skull in the middle and the sculk and gold skulls on either side.
wildways.guide.quest.defeat_wither.descr: Defeat a Wither. Use its Nether Star to craft a beacon. Activating that beacon for the first time grants bonus XP.
